paper_title: On Unambiguous Regular Tree Languages of Index (0,2)
statement: However, we did not consider any decidability issue. It thus remains open to show whether one can decide, given any automaton B and any ordinal 0 < α < ϕ2 (0), whether B <W Abα holds or not.
context: The whole construction is effective. This means that the mapping α ↦ Abα (for 0 < α < ϕ2 (0)) is recursive. And also that, for any 0 < α < β < ϕ2 (0), the relation Abα <W Abβ which stipulates that there exists two strategies – one that is winning for player II in the game W (Abα , Abβ ) and another one that is winning for I in the game W (Abβ , Abα ) – can be established by recursively providing such strategies. However, we did not consider any decidability issue. It thus remains open to show whether one can decide, given any automaton B and any ordinal 0 < α < ϕ2 (0), whether B <W Abα holds or not.
